posts.text: Highway opening, the anchor story of the day, and I'm still stuck on the price tag. Who's paying for Kessa-North and what does it cost per family? Nobody's asked yet. #VelorianElection

Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes

Read the debate summaries twice. Ostrand's inflation defence leaned on averages; the household basket tells a harder story. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing before anyone celebrates. Both deserve the same scrutiny. Numbers first, then votes.

Ostrand cut the ribbon on Kessa–North today. Nice road. Now show me what my diesel and fertiliser cost next month, not the press photo. Those costings question at the debate didn't get a straight answer either.

Watched part of the Kito debate tonight. Arden talking about 200,000 jobs sounds great, but who's costing it? Ostrand dodged the inflation question too. Both need to show their numbers before I vote. #Veloria

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria

Tired nurse take: I'm glad the Kessa highway is finally open, but my ward still has three empty posts and no relief staff. Ostrand, Arden, whoever wins, show me the staffing numbers, not just the jobs slogans. #Veloria
Fuel up, fertiliser up, and Ostrand is cutting ribbons on highways. Nice road, but my diesel bill doesn't care about asphalt. Show me the numbers, not the press photo. #VeloriaVotes
Read the VeriCheck piece twice. The 'double VAT' claim is false, but the 2% GDP gap in Arden's plan is real and nobody has answered it yet. Both camps owe us the costings. Numbers first, then votes.

Fact-check on Arden's VAT and fuel claims is out (VeriCheck). The VAT doubling claim is false; the 40% fuel figure uses a peak month. Worth reading before sharing. Plans still need costing, from both sides. #VeloriaVotes
Two weeks out and every feed is 'show me the numbers.' Fine. Who's actually publishing a costed plan? Not a ribbon, not a slogan. Genuinely asking, I'll read it.
Read the VeriCheck piece. The 2% GDP gap is the number nobody on Arden's side has answered yet. Would love to see it addressed before the vote, not after. #VelorianElection

Before anyone shares a 'DOUBLE VAT' claim, check it. Did the official page say that, or is it a screenshot? Ask the party for the costings document and the commission's fact sheet. Numbers first. #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Kessa–North is a nice road, I'll admit it. My back thanks the government. My wallet still wants to know what the fuel and groceries will cost next month. Show me the numbers, Ostrand and Arden both. #VeloriaVotes

VBC dropped a 'questions raised' clip on Arden and the Civic Front says it's fake. Cool. Who's authenticating it? Nobody's shown a forensic check yet. Wait for the verification before anyone reshares. #VeloriaVotes
Two days of 'show me the numbers' and still no costings from either side. Fuel and fertiliser keep climbing. Ostrand, Arden, whoever: publish the plan, not the photo op. #VeloriaVotes

Got a WhatsApp voice note 'leaked audio' of Arden and a VBC clip, both with no source. Before I forward anything to my cousins, I want the original file and who recorded it. Not sharing till we know. Numbers and proof first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 3 and the WhatsApp 'leaked audio' is going round with 'forward before it gets deleted!!' Not sharing a clip I can't verify. Wait for the commission or a proper fact-check. Numbers first, forwards later. #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip in full. Whatever it is, one recording two weeks out is not something to decide on from a single clip. Ask for the provenance and the chain of custody before anyone repeats it. Numbers first, then votes.

Day 3 and I'm still seeing a 'leaked audio' forward going round that nobody can trace. Before you forward anything, ask who recorded it, where it came from, and whether VBC or any outlet has verified it. Not sharing this one. #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip. Who has verified the recording? Source, date, chain of custody? 'Questions raised' isn't an answer. Wait for the commission or a forensic check before anyone treats it as fact. #VelorianElection

VBC is playing a 'questions raised' clip about a recording of Mr Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before sharing: who released the file, when, and has any outlet verified the audio or its metadata? Ask the commission and check VeriCheck. Don't spread it until it's confirmed. #VeloriaVotes

The Ledger's 'diverted road funds' story is a serious allegation, and the ministry calling it fabricated doesn't settle it either way. Before anyone repeats it: what exactly do the documents show, and has any outlet verified them? Numbers and provenance first, then votes.
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the ±3 margin, so it's a coin toss. Good. Now show me the costings from both camps before I decide. A promise is a loan. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 check before sharing anything: the 'running mate has a foreign passport / will sell the port' claim from Veloria Patriots Daily has no source, no document, and no quote. Also, the Kito TV poll has a ±3 margin, so Ostrand 46 vs Arden 44 is a statistical tie. Check the claim with VeriCheck and the commission before forwarding. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 days out and the Kito poll has Ostrand 46 / Arden 44 with 10% undecided and ±3 margin. Basically a coin flip lol. Also the 'running mate has a foreign passport' headline from Veloria Patriots Daily: where's the document? Anyone seen a source that isn't a headline?
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's inside the ±3 margin, so basically a coin toss. Nine days to go. Still want the costings from both sides before I decide. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says 46 Ostrand, 44 Arden, 10 undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Before I trust any headline, I want to see both sides' costed plans, not just the margin. Nurses have heard enough slogans. #Veloria

Kito TV's poll is 46 to 44 with 10% undecided and a ±3 margin. That's a statistical tie. Anyone calling this a lock for either side is selling something. Also, the Ledger's road-funds story: the ministry says fabricated. Show me the documents or wait. #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided. Fine, close race. But my diesel bill is what matters to me, and neither side has put a costed plan on the table. Show me the numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out and we've got two trending tags, #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, that researchers say were mostly made this month and posted near-identical text. Who's running those accounts? Check before you reshare. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. The commission has published its results-transmission procedure: forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Good. Before we argue over any leaked clip, go read the official procedure yourselves. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Got a WhatsApp forward offering 'community ambassador' money: 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to push a party? That's not a volunteer, that's an ad with a bot link. Who's paying? Check before you click. #VeloriaVotes

Nine days out and I'm still reading 'show me the numbers' from every feed. Fuel and fertiliser keep climbing on my farm. Arden, Ostrand, whoever: publish the costed plan, not another photo op. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. Two things to check before anyone shares: that WhatsApp 'ambassador' link paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 vel per Unity polling station is a red flag, not a job. And the commission says results forms get scanned to VeloResults, so watch that portal and ask observers to the system test. Numbers and sources first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out. The commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers can attend a system test. Before the vote, go look at the process itself instead of trusting screenshots. Read it, then ask questions. #VelorianElection

Commission says results forms will be scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, with observers invited to test it. Good. Transparency on the pipeline matters as much as the numbers. Let's watch the test before we trust the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 to go. Two trending hashtags, dozens of accounts made this month posting near-identical lines. Before I trust either #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, I want the costed plans and the VeloResults numbers. Nurses have heard enough slogans. #Veloria

Day 6, 7 to go. That forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels, check the IECV site and VeloResults, or call the commission directly. Don't trust a WhatsApp letterhead. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Kito TV clip of President Ostrand mispronouncing a town's name is going round. Before sharing: is the full clip verified, unedited, with date and source? 'Slip of the tongue' is her team's line, not a fact check. Look at the full footage, then decide. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Mara fluffed a provincial town name on Kito TV and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Lol, fair enough, we all butcher names. Still not voting on a blooper though. Show me the costed plans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. That 'IECV letter' moving 212 Northern polling stations 'for security reasons' is going round WhatsApp with no reference number and no link to the commission site. Before you forward or change your plans, check the official IECV notices and VeloResults. Real changes get published, not whispered. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 to go. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving. Before anyone forwards it: check the IECV site and the commission's list. Tired nurse here, I've seen enough viral 'official' notices this month. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip of the mispronounced town name is going round. Fine, slips happen. The real question for Ostrand's record is the 2% GDP gap nobody has costed yet. Mispronunciations don't answer that. Numbers first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going around. Honestly? A slip is a slip. Mispronounce a name and move on. The real question is still the 2% GDP gap in the costings. Address that, then we can talk about tongues. #VelorianElection

Day 6 and a 'polling stations moving' letter is doing the rounds on WhatsApp. 212 stations in the north, 'security concerns', and no link to the commission. Before anyone forwards it to their cousins: check IECV's site and call your local office. Who actually signed this? #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Got a WhatsApp voice note telling us to stay home tomorrow because 'it's covered.' Don't. Vote, and check the IECV notices and VeloResults yourself. Nobody's 'covered' but the voter. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so no more party stuff from me. Got a WhatsApp voice note from 'Tomas Arden' telling everyone to stay home tomorrow. Stay home from what? Anyone can record a voice note. Check the IECV site before you believe it. Vote, don't skip it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. Two weeks of noise is over. Before polls close: VeloResults is where forms get published, so bookmark it now. Quiet week, check your sources. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Before anything else: the 'Tomas says stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note has no source. Don't act on it. Check IECV and VeloResults. Vote for who you choose, not who a forward tells you to skip. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. So for the next few days we get... memes and forwards instead of debates? Lol. Still want the 2% GDP gap costed before I pick a side. Quiet week, loud WhatsApp. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight, so take a breath before you forward anything. The 2% GDP gap in Ostrand's record still hasn't been costed by anyone I've seen. Show me the working from either camp before you decide. Numbers first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so the only thing left to read is the official stuff. Before you share the singer's 'danger to our children' clip, who posted the full video and when? Check the source first. #VelorianElection

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high and the commission says some ID kits failed in the north, so they switched to the printed register as the law allows. If you're voting today, bring whatever ID you have and check the IECV notices. Results get scanned to VeloResults. Watch that, not the screenshots.

Election day and the WhatsApp forwards are already flying. 212 stations moving? Pre-stuffed boxes in Coast Province? Before you share ANY photo or letter, check IECV notices and VeloResults. Don't trust a letterhead. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North, so officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Not a scandal, just a fallback. The 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo has no source or date. Before you share, check VeloResults and the IECV updates. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check IECV notices before you believe any 'stations closed' forward. Vote, then watch VeloResults for the scanned forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls are open! Some ID kits failed in the North so they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check the IECV notices and VeloResults before you believe any photo. Go vote! #VeloriaVotes
Election day in Veloria. Polls are open, so check the IECV notices and VeloResults, not WhatsApp 'official letters' or voice notes. Vote for the plan you've actually read. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the Commission says some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so they fell back to the printed register, which the law allows. Fine. Vote, then watch VeloResults for the scanned forms. Process matters as much as the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Voted, and the printed register worked fine for me. Not sharing any screenshots though. Check IECV and VeloResults yourself before you believe anything, including whatever's in your WhatsApp. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two exit-style tallies, Kito TV 51-47 Arden and VBC 53-45 Ostrand, and they count different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. Patience is cheaper than a wrong headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Polls closed, counting underway. Two exit tallies, Kito TV says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, and they count different stations first. Neither is the result. Wait for VeloResults, the scanned forms. Don't post screenshots of tallies. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither tally means much yet. Civic Front says they won? Wait for VeloResults scans. Don't call it till the forms are up. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV and VBC show opposite leads, but each counted different stations first, so neither tally means much yet. @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' has no official source behind it. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. Tired, but not gullible. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls still open. Two exit-style tallies from Kito TV and VBC give opposite leaders with different station samples, so neither means anything yet. Wait for official counts on VeloResults. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, results night. Kito TV and VBC have tallies that disagree because they count different stations first, so neither is the result yet. Hold the screenshots, including the 'FINAL RESULTS' one from an account with no verification. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV says Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations. VBC says Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us much yet. Wait for VeloResults to publish the scanned forms before deciding who's ahead. Numbers first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two 'results' already contradict each other: Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%, and some blue tick is posting 54.2%. They each counted different stations first lol. Wait for VeloResults + IECV, not whatever's trending. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the Patriots Daily 'PROVES Arden won 9/14 provinces' page is citing a portal that the commission says is glitched, with 41% of forms up. A glitch doesn't prove a winner. Wait for IECV + VeloResults scans. Tired of this wild west. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. The IECV says 41% of station forms are up on VeloResults and the rest are still being collated by hand. A 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim can't be checked from that. VeriCheck has already rated it false. Wait for the full scan. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Commission says 41% of forms are up and the rest are being collated by hand. Two exit tallies disagree, so neither tells us who won. Hold the screenshots. Wait for VeloResults and the scanned forms. #VelorianElection

Day 10. The Commission says only 41% of forms are online and the portal can't show a province winner yet. So the '9 of 14' claim is premature at best. Hold the victory posts until the scanned forms are up on VeloResults. Numbers first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still waiting on VeloResults: only 41% of station forms are up, and the portal glitch explains the gap. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post and the 54.2% claim have no official source. Two exit tallies counting different stations first don't tell us who won. Wait for the scanned forms. Patience, like a slow pot, still cooks the rice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Still no VeloResults numbers, only 41% of forms online and a 'technical glitch.' Kito TV and VBC disagree, and some blue tick says 54.2%. Nobody has the counted forms yet. Wait for the scanned results before you believe a headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 night, still no VeloResults. 41% of forms online and the rest is 'glitch'. Kito, VBC, and the 'FINAL RESULTS' account all disagree, and they all counted different stations. I'm not calling it from a screenshot. Wait for the scanned forms, then we talk. Taxi's off the clock, I'm just refreshing IECV. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 + 41% of forms online and VeloResults is stuck on a 'glitch'. Kito says Arden, VBC says Ostrand, and neither has a single scanned form behind it. Until the forms are up, nobody gets to call this. Check IECV notices before you share anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. Official count, not a tally or a 'FINAL' screenshot. Accepted as declared. If you think the scanned forms don't match, file it through the IECV, not a viral thread. #VelorianElection

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'manipulated' and they're going to court. Fine, let them go to court. But 41% of forms were online on day 10 and the rest was 'glitch'. Show me the scanned forms for the whole country before anybody tells me the count was fixed or clean. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. Whatever you think of the result, that's the official count, and the forms should back it up on VeloResults. Still want to see the full scan before I call it. Rest now, everyone. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The Commission has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Those are the official numbers from IECV. The exit tallies and the 'FINAL RESULTS' posts were never the result. Whoever you backed, let's accept the count and watch how the losing side handles it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The regional observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, so it's worth reading their full statement too. Accept the result, keep scrutinising the process. Check IECV notices, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the IECV finally declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, from the actual commission. Now maybe the 'FINAL RESULTS' account and the 54.2% blue tick can stop. Vote-count fatigue is real lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected at 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result, scanned forms should back it up on VeloResults. Congrats to the winner, and to everyone who waited patiently. Now let's get back to traffic. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in: IECV declares Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Ten days of 'FINAL RESULTS' and exit-tally noise, and the official count is what it is. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays, which deserves scrutiny in its own right. Numbers first, and the margin is a 2.7-point gap. Let's see the scanned forms on VeloResults before anyone claims more.

Day 12. Kito says the court is making the commission open its servers to both sides. Good. VBC's riot footage is burning tyres, not proof of anything. Let the logs and the scanned forms speak. Taxi's back on the road. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. If Arden's team has a case, let the courts and the scanned forms settle it. Ostrand's margin is 2.7 points, so verify, don't vibe. Patience, like slow rice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The Supreme Court has ordered the commission to give both sides supervised access to servers and logs. That's the right step. Petition filed, process running. Check IECV notices and the court's filings, not screenshots. Let the process finish. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and Kito TV says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. Good. If the forms are clean, a look at the logs should show it. Wait for the review, not the spin. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petitioned and the court is ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's what a contested count should look like. Let the audit run before anyone calls it stolen or confirmed. #VelorianElection

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is going to the Supreme Court and the court ordered both sides supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let them look. Still don't want anyone calling it fixed or clean before the scanned forms are all up. Check IECV, not the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition is going to court, and the Supreme Court wants both sides to get supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's what a real dispute looks like. Let the logs speak. Scanned forms on VeloResults, not clips. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV reports the Civic Front petition and the court-ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the right channel for a dispute, and it's the same process the rest of us should be watching. Let the audit run its course. Numbers first, and we'll see what the logs show.
